371ba48d25a883df.description: Job description: Under the authority of the Maintenance Manager, the AGL Engineer is responsible for the inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of Aeronautical Ground Lighting (AGL) at airport facilities. This role ensures system reliability, safety compliance, and operational efficiency by conducting preventive and corrective maintenance, collaborating across teams, and maintaining detailed records. Job Description Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance of Aeronautical Ground Lighting (AGL) systems, including runway and taxiway lighting, guidance signs, circuits, cables, transformers, Constant Current Regulators (CCRs), and associated control and monitoring equipment. Identify, troubleshoot, and promptly address faults to maintain the safe and reliable operation of AGL systems. Replace or repair damaged and malfunctioning components in response to planned maintenance or emergency requests, minimizing system downtime. Perform electrical, functional, and operational tests after maintenance or repair to verify system performance and confirm that equipment is safe to return to service. Analyze system alarms, circuit faults, and equipment malfunctions to determine root causes and implement appropriate corrective actions. Respond to emergency callouts and participate in a 24/7 standby rotation, as required. Follow airport safety requirements, electrical safety procedures, operational rules, and approved standard operating procedures during all work activities. Ensure the required permits and work documents, including LOA permits and AWP documentation, are available and approved before work begins. Conduct Toolbox Talks and safety briefings with the shift team, promoting clear communication and awareness of worksite and airside hazards. Coordinate with the Airport Operations Team and other relevant stakeholders to obtain work approvals, arrange access, and complete operational handovers following maintenance. Accurately update work orders and preventive and corrective maintenance records in Oracle or other designated systems. Prepare and submit clear shift reports detailing work performed, AGL faults and alarms, equipment status, outstanding issues, and other relevant activities. Participate in technical and safety training to maintain up-to-date knowledge of AGL equipment, airport standards, and applicable procedures. Recommend improvements to maintenance processes and work practices to enhance AGL system reliability, safety, and operational efficiency. Keep tools, vehicles, and equipment clean, serviceable, and ready for use. Monitor AGL equipment during operation, promptly reporting any abnormal conditions or safety concerns. Exercise due care when working airside and strictly observe airport-specific safety, access, and work-control requirements. Skills/Qualification Requirement 8 – 10 years of Experience in AGL maintenance, including facilities maintenance (CCR, Transformers, Connectors, Network Switches, Network Troubleshooting, Electrical device and instruments) Relevant technical qualifications in AGL or a related field. Previous experience in AGL maintenance and troubleshooting. Skilled in the use of standard and specialized tools used in this work. Education Minimum Diploma in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from an internationally recognized institution. 376740d80cee3e49.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسس لتحصيل الديون عن محصل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة من الجهات والأشخاص، مع ضمان الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد كشوفات تفصيلية بالمبالغ المستحقة من الجهات والأشخاص. تحصيل المبالغ النقدية المستحقة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. تسجيل المبالغ المحصلة وتحديث الكشوفات بشكل مستمر ودقيق. المتابعة والتنسيق مع الأطراف المعنية لضمان تحصيل المبالغ والرد على استفساراتهم. الالتزام التام بالتعليمات المتعلقة بسرية المعاملات المالية والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. حفظ النسخ الورقية من سندات القبض والوثائق ذات الصلة، وترتيبها وفقاً للسياسات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التحصيل أو ما يعادله. القدرة على إعداد الكشوفات المالية وتحديثها. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للمتابعة والتنسيق مع الجهات المختلفة. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تسجيل المعاملات المالية. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة للعمل. القدرة على التعامل مع المعلومات بسرية ومهنية. مهارات تنظيمية لحفظ الوثائق والسجلات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. يعمل المحصل ضمن فريق متخصص في تحصيل الديون، ويسهم في الحفاظ على سير العمليات المالية بسلاسة وفعالية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة اسس لتحصيل الديون.

3725bcbfbe249b0b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المركز المعماري للاستشارات الهندسية عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحديد المخاطر المهنية في بيئات ومواقع العمل المختلفة، ووضع برامج للوقاية من الأمراض المهنية، وضمان تطبيق معايير الصحة والسلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة بيئة العمل وتحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية. اقتراح أساليب وإجراءات فعالة لتفادي تأثيرات المخاطر على العاملين. تنسيق الفحوصات الطبية الدورية للعاملين للتأكد من عدم تأثرهم بأمراض مهنية. قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج في مواقع العمل ومقارنتها بالمعايير المقبولة. التوصية بالإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة لتحسين بيئة العمل. مراقبة ومتابعة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية السائلة والصلبة لضمان عدم تأثيرها على صحة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال الصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالصحة المهنية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال جميع أعمال الصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية. معرفة بإجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد المخاطر وتقييمها. القدرة على تصميم وتطوير برامج الوقاية من الأمراض المهنية. مهارات إعداد التقارير والوثائق وحفظها بدقة. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة العامة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الصحة والسلامة المهنية في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التواجد في مواقع العمل المختلفة بالرياض، مع التركيز على تطبيق أفضل ممارسات الصحة والسلامة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وسيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

3731acef1bf331c0.description: About Ektis Ektis is a management consultancy firm that provides transformation, advisory, and execution services across the Middle East Banking sector. The firm focuses on strategy, operations, digital, and people, aiming to build trust and create sustainable impact. Since its launch, Ektis has expanded to over 100 employees within six months, with a strong presence in KSA and a growing regional footprint. The company plans significant scaling by 2027, expanding both its capabilities and regional reach. Role Overview Ektis is seeking a Sourcing Senior Specialist to lead proactive, direct sourcing and headhunting efforts, initially focusing on the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) and supporting broader regional expansion. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is delivery-focused and involves identifying, mapping, and engaging passive talent directly. The specialist will run targeted headhunting campaigns and execute team lift-outs and multi-hire initiatives from competitors, working alongside the Talent Acquisition Lead to manage the sourcing engine. Key Responsibilities Identify, research, and proactively approach passive candidates through direct outreach, headhunting, referrals, and networking for live roles across all business areas. Build detailed maps of target companies, teams, and individuals across KSA and the wider region, maintaining intelligence on market movement and compensation benchmarks. Plan and execute team lift-outs and multi-hires from competitors, identifying intact teams and managing discreet, multi-threaded outreach. Develop and maintain warm, segmented talent pipelines for priority and recurring roles to reduce reliance on external agencies. Conduct initial conversations to qualify candidate motivation, fit, and availability, and maintain engagement with passive candidates over longer cycles. Collaborate with hiring managers and the Talent Acquisition Lead to take detailed briefs, calibrate profiles, and provide real-time market insights. Utilize LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, talent databases, referrals, and other channels to source talent not responsive to advertised roles. Support sourcing for graduate, early careers, and internship hiring, including building university relationships and identifying emerging talent pools. Track sourcing activity and pipeline metrics, using data to refine targeting and report on progress. Ensure sourcing activities comply with company policies, Middle East labor considerations, and DEI principles, maintaining a professional candidate experience. Candidate Profile and Requirements The ideal candidate will possess 5-10 years of hands-on sourcing or research experience, preferably gained in executive search, RPO, an agency, or an in-house sourcing team. Experience with the Middle East market and a working understanding of hiring in KSA are essential. Exposure to consulting, professional services, or financial services is an advantage. The role requires a strong ability in market mapping and talent intelligence, with confidence in direct headhunting outreach and managing team lift-outs discreetly. Candidates should be fluent in modern sourcing tools and techniques, including Boolean search and LinkedIn Recruiter, and adopt a data-informed mindset to improve sourcing effectiveness while maintaining a human touch in candidate engagement. Work Environment This role operates within a growing, entrepreneurial environment where the ability to thrive amidst ambiguity is valued. The position is focused on delivery and sourcing, requiring a candidate who is motivated to be deeply engaged in the market daily and contribute to building the sourcing capability that supports the firm's regional growth. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this position to contribute to Ektis's expansion in Riyadh and across the region.

37a1e95e132f268a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مدارس دور العلوم الأهلية عن معلم للمرحلة الثانوية للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم تعليم عالي الجودة للطلاب في مجال التخصص، مع التركيز على تطوير خطط الدروس وتقديم الدعم التعليمي الفردي والجماعي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدريس الطلاب في مجال التخصص المحدد، مع ضمان فهمهم للمادة العلمية. وضع خطط الدروس التفصيلية بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة. تقديم التعليمات الفردية والجماعية للطلاب، مع مراعاة الفروق الفردية في التعلم. دعم التنمية الشاملة للطلاب، أكاديمياً وشخصياً. اختيار المصادر التعليمية المناسبة التي تثري العملية التعليمية. تصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس وطرق التدريس والمحتوى التعليمي بشكل فعال وجذاب. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التدريس أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع خطط الدروس وتصميم المحتوى التعليمي. مهارات تواصل ممتازة والقدرة على التفاعل بفعالية مع الطلاب. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في شركة مدارس دور العلوم الأهلية بالهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق من المعلمين والإداريين لتقديم أفضل تجربة تعليمية للطلاب. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم لهذا الدور في شركة مدارس دور العلوم الأهلية.

373c8844ab6bd3e2.description: يعلن مشغل نسائي راقٍ في مدينة الرياض عن توفر فرص وظيفية لعدد من الموظفات في التخصصات التالية: • كوافيرة / مصففة شعر • أخصائية صبغات وعلاجات الشعر • أخصائية أظافر (Nail Technician) • أخصائية بديكير ومناكير • أخصائية مكياج • أخصائية عناية بالبشرة • أخصائية حمام مغربي • موظفة استقبال وخدمة عملاء المتطلبات: خبرة مناسبة في مجال التخصص. الاحترافية وحسن التعامل مع العميلات. الالتزام بالمواعيد وساعات العمل. الاهتمام بالنظافة والمظهر العام. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. المميزات: راتب شهري ثابت. حوافز وعمولات حسب الوظيفة والأداء. بيئة عمل راقية ومنظمة. فرص للتطور والاستقرار الوظيفي. 📍 مكان العمل: الرياض 🕐 نوع الدوام: دوام كامل يرجى التقديم عبر منصة صبار مع توضيح التخصص، سنوات الخبرة، والراتب المتوقع.

372a81e4dee21b34.company_name: مكتب د علي صالح الدهيمان للاستشارات البيئيه
372a81e4dee21b34.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب د علي صالح الدهيمان للاستشارات البيئيه عن أخصائي استشارات أعمال للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم الاستشارات الفنية والإشراف على الفحوص والتحاليل الميكروبيولوجية للأغذية، مع ضمان جودة النتائج وكفاءة طرق الكشف عن الملوثات ومسببات الأمراض. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف الفني على الفحوص الميكروبيولوجية للأغذية ومراجعة جودة نتائجها. متابعة تطبيق طرق الفحص التقليدية والتقنيات السريعة والجزيئية للكشف عن مسببات الأمراض. وضع وتدقيق إجراءات العمل القياسية (SOPs). الإشراف على إعداد خطط التحقق من صلاحية طرق التحليل وتأكيد أدائها (Method Validation & Verification). متابعة تطبيق متطلبات المواصفة ISO/IEC 17025:2017 المتعلقة بالتحاليل الميكروبيولوجية. تقييم بيئة المختبر ومراقبة الأداء الفني وجودة نتائج التحاليل. متابعة أنظمة التتبع والتوثيق وإعداد تقارير النتائج. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الاستشارات الفنية أو الإشراف على التحاليل الميكروبيولوجية. فهم عميق لمتطلبات المواصفة ISO/IEC 17025:2017 وتطبيقها في المختبرات. القدرة على مراجعة إجراءات العمل وضمان كفاءة طرق الكشف عن الملوثات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم جودة النتائج والأداء الفني. القدرة على وضع وتدقيق إجراءات العمل القياسية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لإعداد التقارير الفنية وتقديم الاستشارات. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والدقة في جميع المهام. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي استشارات الأعمال في مكتب د علي صالح الدهيمان للاستشارات البيئيه في مدينة مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المكتب لتقديم الدعم الفني والإشراف على العمليات المخبرية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

3792a4789871a076.description: BlueFive Sidra is pleased to announce a Tamheer training opportunity within its Development Management Unit (DMU) for the position of Project Management Specialist. Tamheer is the on-the-job training program offered by the Human Resources Development Fund (HRDF), designed to provide Saudi graduates with practical and professional experience that enhances their readiness for the labor market for more information, click here Role Overview The selected trainee will support the DMU team in project controls and portfolio reporting, ensuring that project cost, schedule, progress, risk, and documentation information is maintained accurately and kept up to date. Key Responsibilities Collect monthly progress updates from consultants and developers and update the Real Estate Development Platform (RDP) Update master schedules and extract critical project milestones Cross-check invoices against consultant certificates, BOQs/CBS, previous invoices, retention, and advances Attend site visits, take photographs, document observations, and follow up on previous action items Maintain accurate and up-to-date project document registers Requirements Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Project Management, or a related field Fresh graduate with an interest in real estate development and project management Strong analytical and organizational skills Good attention to detail and communication skills Tamheer Eligibility Criteria (per HRDF) Saudi national, aged 30 or below Registered on the HRDF (Hadaf) platform Not currently employed in the public or private sector Prior work experience not exceeding one year BlueFive Sidra adheres to Saudi Arabia labor laws and is committed to providing equal opportunities for all candidates, including individuals with disabilities. We foster an inclusive work environment where everyone is respected, supported, and empowered to contribute to our success.

375463777a9c34ec.description: About Vanderlande Vanderlande is a global leader in value-added logistic process automation for airports and the parcel market. The company is also a key supplier of process automation solutions for warehouses. Vanderlande focuses on developing cutting-edge solutions and technologies, operating with the mantra, “In a world of technology, a belief in people.” The Role of Controls Project Engineer As a Controls Project Engineer, you will join a multidisciplinary team of engineers, collaborating closely with Project Leaders, Integration Managers, and Mechanical and Electrical Engineers. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically covering projects in Jeddah and Makkah, and involves managing technical solutions related to control engineering. Key Responsibilities Design and program PLC controls for material handling systems within the Airports domain, ensuring high-quality standards for each project. Collaborate with the multidisciplinary project team to deliver Functional Specifications during the engineering phase. Manage the detailed design, programming, and testing of PLC software. Travel to customer sites to commission material handling systems upon completion of the engineering phase. Conduct functional testing of PLC hardware and software during the commissioning phase. Integrate PLC software into the overall control system and support customer acceptance testing. Monitor project budgets and schedules closely during execution, taking necessary actions as required. Project Management and Support This role involves supporting sales during the bid and contract phases by providing technical expertise in control engineering. During the execution phase, you will work towards the successful completion of one or more international projects, ensuring adherence to budget and schedule. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in controls project engineering. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, with project responsibilities spanning cities such as Jeddah and Makkah. The role operates within an international project environment, requiring collaboration with diverse engineering teams.

3797c561975a5c43.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform designed for emerging markets. With over 25 years of conversational AI research and development, the company serves more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA. Unifonic is recognized as a Great Place to Work® and is pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform. Role Overview Unifonic is seeking a Key Account Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic enterprise customers while driving business growth. The Key Account Manager will be responsible for managing key accounts, understanding customer objectives, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering value through Unifonic’s solutions. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise customers. Develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders and executive sponsors. Create and execute strategic account plans. Identify opportunities for account expansion through additional products and services. Conduct regular business reviews and ensure customer satisfaction. Collaborate with Customer Success and other internal teams to maximize customer value. Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, and CRM records. Build relationships with prospective enterprise customers through networking, referrals, and industry engagement. Lead commercial discussions and solution presentations. Prepare proposals, negotiate contracts, and support the sales process through deal closure. Contribute to achieving the team’s revenue and growth objectives. Required Skills and Attributes Exceptional relationship management abilities. Strategic thinking and strong commercial acumen. Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use data to find solutions. Strong sense of ownership and accountability, ensuring projects are completed. Clear communication skills, capable of explaining ideas and listening across teams. Ability to collaborate effectively and support team goals. Adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning. Mentorship and knowledge-sharing capabilities. Resilience under pressure and constructive handling of setbacks. Commitment to quality and attention to detail. Advocacy for best practices, efficiency, and innovation. Experience Requirements Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant professional experience in key account management or a similar role within the enterprise sector. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

37ca6be6a79ede26.description: About the Role Al-Futtaim is seeking a Customer Support Representative, Commercial Vehicles to join the FAMCO KSA team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role serves as the primary point of contact for customers, supporting showroom operations and coordinating with various internal teams to ensure a smooth customer experience. Key Responsibilities Serve as the first point of contact for customers, responding to sales, service, and general inquiries promptly and professionally. Handle customer concerns and complaints in line with company service standards. Support walk-in customers and coordinate their requirements with the sales and aftersales teams. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, transactions, deliveries, and communications. Contribute to customer satisfaction and retention through responsive and reliable service. Coordinate with sales, aftersales, warehouse, and logistics teams to support seamless order processing and fulfillment. Prepare delivery schedules and ensure all required documentation is complete. Maintain and update stock reports to support accurate inventory tracking and reporting. Prepare daily stock and sales reports, supporting stock updates and provision calculations. Create and update customer information, vendor accounts, and related data. Prepare and process payments and invoices in accordance with company procedures. Monitor receivables and follow up on outstanding customer payments. Review and verify work orders before billing to ensure accuracy. Submit invoices to customers promptly and maintain proper supporting records. Ensure compliance with applicable safety regulations and manufacturer guidelines. Team and Reporting Structure The Customer Support Representative will be part of the FAMCO KSA team and will report directly to the Regional Aftersales Manager. This role involves close collaboration with colleagues across sales, aftersales, warehouse, and logistics to coordinate customer requirements, deliveries, order fulfillment, and showroom operations. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time position are encouraged to apply.

37e9240647b73e38.description: About the Role SFC is seeking a Modern Trade Key Account Officer to join their team in the Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on managing key accounts within modern trade channels, ensuring the achievement of sales and collection targets. The position is open to candidates with 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Role Overview The Modern Trade Key Account Officer is responsible for driving key performance indicators, including volume, visibility, and collection, across assigned accounts. This involves strategic planning, execution of commercial activities, and close collaboration with various departments to ensure operational efficiency and financial compliance. Key Responsibilities Achieve annual and monthly sales targets set by the head office. Ensure the execution of all planned activities and contractual agreements (BDAs) for managed accounts. Monitor and ensure compliance with all financial aspects of the account to maximize return on investment through correct execution of commercial plans and financial policies. Contribute to the development of the company's overall sales strategy. Meet monthly collection targets from managed accounts, aiming for 100% settlement. Plan activities at least 8 weeks in advance, providing all necessary supporting documentation for full programming and reporting. Plan appropriate customer service levels, including sales calls, activities, product displays, and logistics, by collaborating closely with different departments. Prepare accurate and timely reports, ensuring alignment with company policies and requirements. Required Experience 0-1 years of professional experience in a relevant field. Work Location This position is based in the Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia, covering cities such as Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Al Qatif, Ras Tannurah, Al Khafji, Buqayq, Al Hafuf, Al Mubarraz, Safwa, Sayhat, Tarut, Inak, Darin, and Umm Al Hamam. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3739940d7bfe226a.description: About the Role Umrahbookings is seeking a Head of Contracting to lead the company's hotel contracting strategy and commercial accommodation portfolio. This is a full-time, senior leadership position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, reporting directly to the CEO and Head of Commercial. The role involves developing the overall contracting strategy, expanding Umrahbookings' hotel network, and leading the Contracting team. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement the overall hotel contracting strategy, establish annual contracting objectives with the CEO, identify strategic opportunities across Makkah, Madinah, and other Saudi destinations, build a scalable contracting structure, and establish contracting targets, KPIs, and performance reporting. Hotel Partnerships: Lead negotiations with key hotels and hotel groups, develop strategic relationships with senior hotel management, secure competitive rates and preferential commercial terms, negotiate allocations and inventory commitments, identify opportunities for exclusive or preferred rates, and develop long-term strategic partnerships. Team Management: Lead and develop the Contracting Manager and Contracting Executives, establish clear individual and departmental KPIs, build processes for hotel acquisition, contracting, renewal, and performance management, train and mentor the contracting team, and conduct regular performance reviews and pipeline meetings. Commercial Management: Monitor hotel production, revenue, and profitability, analyze booking trends and agent demand, identify underperforming contracts and develop corrective strategies, ensure the hotel portfolio meets the needs of Umrahbookings' international agency network, and collaborate with Sales, Reservations, Marketing, and Operations. Seasonal Strategy: Lead contracting preparation for Ramadan, Hajj, peak Umrah periods, school holidays, Saudi public holidays, and international travel peaks.
